intent: A fat man sits at a fine-dining table behind a lavish dinner (tomahawk steak, lobster, seafood tower, red wine), facing the camera, chest up. START: right hand holds a fork with one piece of steak just above the plate, left hand flat on the tablecloth, whiny poor-me look, mouth closed. END: both hands lifted in a helpless shrug, shoulders up; right hand still holds the same fork and steak beside his right shoulder, left hand open palm up beside his left shoulder; head tilted, eyebrows raised, mouth closed. Nothing on the table moves. The clip will be lip-synced later, so the mouth is closed in both frames. MOTION (the part of the take the edit uses, about 4.2 s): locked camera; he holds the whiny look, then lifts both hands into the shrug within about 1.5 s and holds it. Background staff and diners walk and move, softly out of focus; the candle flickers. Nothing on the table moves. Mouth stays closed (lips are synced afterwards).

person.compare_why: a shrug lifts the shoulders and pulls the shoulder landmarks toward the neck; hips and legs are hidden; head width (ear-to-ear and outer-eye mean) is the size measure a chest-up shrug leaves valid, and the head tilts but does not turn

hands.right: holds the fork with one piece of steak in both frames
hands.left: flat on the tablecloth in START, open palm up in END
